Key facts recorded before implementation:

- **Fail-closed is the whole contract.** SIG-REL-D12: Class S unless
  every Class R condition is *proven*. The classifier's verdict ledger
  lands exactly one row per check — `r`, `trigger`, or `unevaluable` —
  and only an all-`r` ledger yields R. An absent suite row, an absent
  descriptor side, an absent withdrawal registry or a malformed record
  is a named unevaluable verdict, never a guess (SIG-ENG-042, RM-6).
- **The classifier consumes, never measures.** V14's `deltas` and V15's
  `gate` evidence are read verbatim out of the emitted
  `sig.release-results/1` docs; the bounds constants (−2 %…+15 %,
  −5 %/+50 %, 20 % source-share floor) sit beside the code cited to
  §7.3 — the classifier compares, it does not re-derive.
- **The standing go is a record, not a mode.** It exists only as the
  operator's adopted `sig.promotion-approval/1` `standing_go` —
  present, adopted, unexpired (earlier of `expires_at` and the next
  sub-round gate), unrevoked, unvoided, and scoped to this candidate's
  code commit. An expired go is honoured once for a release classified
  while it was still valid (the in-flight rule); a bare "continue"
  renews nothing. Voiding is append-only: `registry/approvals/<name>.voided`
  (`sig.standing-go-void/1`) beside the go, written by the classifier
  itself when `ratchet-regression` / `new-source` /
  `part-viii-screen-change` lands — the B-9 void conditions verbatim.
- **The readout is an agent draft with an empty signature slot.** The
  §7.4 fields are filled from release metadata; the draft is labelled
  `agent-drafted`; the required sentences are the spec's verbatim
  ("single maintainer, no second reviewer" — ADR-163; "no human check
  performed" — SIG-CONF-010/ADR-152; the SIG-MEM-009 authorship
  sentence; the two explicit basis options). Signing changes only the
  status line and appends the signature block — the machinery emits the
  draft and never the signature.
- **Equal absence is not a delta.** Two debugging passes on the
  in-bounds fixture (below) pinned this: a `version_schema` field absent
  on *both* descriptor sides is equal, not a change — only asymmetric
  absence or a value delta triggers. And V14's `failures` list sits
  beside `deltas` in the evidence, not inside it — the anomaly check
  reads `evidence["failures"]` where P35.58 wrote it.

## Phase 1 — implementation

- **`exports/src/exports/release_fingerprint.py`** (new, 179 lines) —
  the deterministic template fingerprint: a canonical sha256 over the
  release's template-relevant surface (emitted page templates and
  includes, canonicalised) — the same commit rebuilds the same digest,
  so the §7.3 template-drift check is pure equality on declared
  metadata, never judgement. Stamped into the release metadata by
  `exports/release.py::build_release` and `site_release.py` where V14's
  `template_fingerprint` delta already reads it.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_classify.py`** (new, 1,269 lines) — the three
  pieces:
  - `classify(store, pub, suite, go, now)` — the §7.3 matrix. Reads the
    suite's V14/V15 rows verbatim; per check: `_check_suite` (the S-mode
    results doc names the pub; V1–V14 green, zero waivers — a waiver
    is a named trigger), `_check_deltas` (record/compartment/source
    bounds vs TOTAL_BOUNDS/COMP_BOUNDS/SOURCE_SHARE_FLOOR; V14
    `status == "skip"` — the absent-baseline case — is Class S; V14
    failure lines are `v14-anomaly` triggers), `_check_source_withdrawals`
    (a removed source needs a covering `registry/withdrawals.json`
    entry — absent registry → `unevaluable`, present-without-entry →
    `source-withdrawal-unrecorded`; a new source is the `new-source`
    trigger **and** a go-voiding condition), `_check_licences`,
    `_check_versions` (V14's `version_schema` delta for schema-level
    transitions + the two descriptors' `versions` blocks for declared
    versions — a `policy_version` delta is `part-viii-screen-change`),
    `_check_surfaces` (route-set equality over the integrity manifest,
    normalized so a publication-id prefix is not a route change),
    `_check_environment` (`environment=production`), `_check_cut`
    (journal provenance — scheduled/drift trigger, outside freezes),
    `_check_signed_code` (the code commit equals the last Class-S-signed
    generation's commit). Output: an append-only
    `sig.release-classification/1` record naming every trigger and every
    unevaluable check.
  - `evaluate_standing_go` + `record_go_void` — the go's six validity
    conditions (present, adopted, unexpired, unrevoked, unvoided,
    in-scope); the in-flight rule; the append-only `.voided` marker.
  - `draft_readout` + `write_readout` — the §7.4 field fill into the
    labelled agent-drafted pair (`registry/readouts/` markdown + the
    `sig.release-readout/1` JSON twin); `signature` emitted empty.
  - `notify_classification` — `release.readout-pending` (S) /
    `release.classified` (R — the diff+check-results mail the go text
    promises) through `alerts`, recorded before any delivery attempt.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_pipeline.py`** (+99/−x) — `verb_classify` is
  the real classifier now: loads the suite docs, runs `classify`, on
  `--apply` writes the classification object create-if-absent, appends
  the `classified` journal event (one `now` threaded through
  classification + journal), appends the go-void marker when a voiding
  trigger lands, drafts the readout on Class S, and records the notice.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_conf.py`** (+87/−x) — `check_approval` extended:
  `standing_go` records validate the full condition set (adoption
  asserted, expiry, revocation, the `.voided` marker, code-commit scope
  against the journaled classification); `signed_readout` keeps its
  shape (pub-named, `signature` present — presence-checked, never
  verified in-pipeline). `verb_promote` reads the journal's class —
  `--class` can never promote against it; a classification's triggers
  refuse a go scoped to different commit.
- **`ops/src/ops/cli.py`** (+25) — `sig-ops release classify` flags
  (`--publication-id`/`--results`/`--go`/`--apply`).
- **`docs/adr/ADR-221-*.md`** (new) — the sign-off-scope ADR: what an
  operator signature means. Seven decisions (consume-never-measure; the
  R-column verbatim incl. the named `part-viii-screen-change`; the go's
  validity + append-only voiding; the draft's empty signature slot and
  verbatim posture wording; the recorded notice through `alerts` with no
  committed address; the deterministic fingerprint; the no-readout set
  untouched). `## Revisit trigger` present.
- **`docs/research/_meta/spec_src/99a_appF_adr.md`** — the ADR-221
  Appendix F row; `docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md` regenerated via
  `BUILD.sh` (generated file, never hand-edited). `docs/adr/README.md`

- **`docs/build/COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv`** — SIG-REL-012 + SIG-CONF-010 flip

- **`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md`** — `D-P35.60-1` appended (operator

### Test matrix

`tests/ops/test_release_classify.py` — **61 tests**, one per §7.2/§7.3
cell plus the machinery edges:

| surface | green path | seeded defect(s) → verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `classify` bounds | in-bounds diff → **class_r**, zero triggers | total < −2 % or > +15 % → S; compartment < −5 % or > +50 % → S; source share < 80 % → S |
| suite rows | S-mode doc naming the pub, V1–V14 green, no waivers | missing suite row → `unevaluable`; a waiver → trigger; a non-green V-check → S |
| V14 anomalies | absent baseline (`status: skip`) → S | `evidence.failures` non-empty → `v14-anomaly` trigger |
| sources | same set → r; recorded withdrawal → r | new source → `new-source` + `.voided` written; unrecorded removal → `source-withdrawal-unrecorded`; absent registry → `unevaluable` |
| licences / surfaces | same sets → r | licence delta → trigger; new/removed public route → trigger; pub-prefix normalization is *not* a change |
| versions | equal declared versions → r | any `versions` delta → trigger; `policy_version` → `part-viii-screen-change`; asymmetric absence → trigger, equal absence → not |
| env / cut | `production` + scheduled cut → r | non-production → S; freeze-window/replay/emergency cut → trigger |
| signed code | same commit as last S-signed gen → r | different commit → trigger; no signed generation → `unevaluable` (first release → S) |
| V15 | clean gate → r | `class_s_signal` or ratchet regression → S even when all else is green |
| standing go | adopted/unexpired/in-scope → `valid` | absent/expired/revoked/voided/out-of-scope → refused; expired go honoured once for the in-flight classification, then refused |
| voiding | — | each of the three B-9 triggers appends `sig.standing-go-void/1` beside the go, never edits it |
| readout | §7.4 fields filled; labelled agent-drafted; `signature` empty | both required sentences verbatim; the two basis options; the MEM-009 authorship line |
| notice | `readout-pending`/`classified` recorded through the seam | no address anywhere; recorded before delivery |
| `verb_classify --apply` | classification object + `classified` journal event + (S) readout + notice | dry-run writes nothing; promote reads the journal's class — a conflicting `--class` never overrides |
| promote under a go | journal `class_r` + valid go → applied | expired/voided go → `approval-refused`; Class S without a signed readout → refused |
| no-readout set | — | `rollback` still raises `go-required` before any leg (untouched) |
